name: Alexander Hotel
insider_take: This boutique gem sits in the heart of Polanco, Mexico City's most sophisticated neighborhood, where European elegance meets contemporary Mexican design.
whats_special: The Alexander Hotel occupies a prime location on Presidente Masaryk Avenue, Mexico City's answer to Rodeo Drive. This intimate property features just 65 rooms, each uniquely designed with hand-selected artwork and custom furnishings. The rooftop terrace offers stunning views of Chapultepec Castle, while the hotel's signature restaurant serves innovative Mexican cuisine with international influences.
pro_tip: Book a room on the upper floors facing east for unobstructed views of Chapultepec Park and Castle - it's particularly magical at sunrise when the golden light hits the historic fortress.
dont_miss: Take a morning stroll through adjacent Chapultepec Park, one of the world's largest city parks, then explore the nearby National Museum of Anthropology. The hotel's concierge can arrange exclusive after-hours museum tours. For shopping enthusiasts, luxury boutiques from Cartier to Louis Vuitton are literally steps from your door on Masaryk Avenue.
pros: Prime location in upscale Polanco district with easy access to museums and shopping
Contemporary boutique design with sophisticated modern amenities
Excellent rooftop restaurant and bar with panoramic city views
Professional business facilities and meeting spaces for corporate travelers
cons: Urban setting may lack tranquil atmosphere
